scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web -- --host"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/mobile
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/api && npm test --prefix apps/web
